name: Avg + Gated Std + (Max-Avg) Residual
tagline: Augments global average pooling with two learnable corrections: spatial std (a spread term) and the max-minus-mean residual.
formula: $$\mathrm{Pool}(x) = \bar{x} + \sigma(\alpha)\,\mathrm{std}(x) + (1-\sigma(\alpha))\,(\max(x) - \bar x),$$ where $\bar x, \mathrm{std}(x), \max(x)\in\mathbb{R}^C$ are spatial statistics. If $H\!\cdot\!W = 1$, return $\bar x$.
init_recovers: GAP at α=−∞ (when std and max-mean both contribute 0)
diff_from_baseline: Versus AvgMax / GeM, replaces the single mean-vs-max blend with a triplet (mean, spatial std, max−mean residual), where σ(α) divides total perturbation between the std and the max-residual branches; falls back to GAP on 1×1 maps.

name: Per-Channel Avg/Max Gate
tagline: Replaces GAP with a per-channel gated combination of average and max pooling, with a learned channel gate and a global temperature.

key_hyperparams.name: max_channels
key_hyperparams.role: size of static gate parameter buffer

diff_from_baseline: Versus AvgMax, swaps the fixed 0.5 mixing with per-channel sigmoid gates and a learnable temperature so each channel autonomously slides between mean and max pooling. Excess channels (beyond 2048) just use plain average pooling.

name: Global Max Pool
tagline: Replaces global average pooling with global max pooling — identical to the global_max baseline.
diff_from_baseline: Identical to the global_max baseline (single-line F.adaptive_max_pool2d), no learnable parameters or new mechanism.

name: Variance-Calibrated Softmax Pooling
tagline: Adds a content-adaptive softmax-attention branch to GAP, gated by a normalized per-channel variance score so high-variance channels lean toward saliency pooling.
formula: $$\mathrm{logits}_{h,w} = \bar{x}_{h,w}\cdot\mathrm{softplus}(\alpha),\qquad a_{h,w} = \mathrm{softmax}_{h,w}(\mathrm{logits}),\qquad \bar{x}_{h,w} = \tfrac{1}{C}\sum_c x_{c,h,w},$$ $$g_c = \sigma\!\left(\frac{\mathrm{Var}_{h,w}(x_c)}{|\mathrm{GAP}(x)_c| + \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_{h,w}(x_c)} + \varepsilon} + b\right),\qquad \mathrm{Pool}(x)_c = \mathrm{GAP}(x)_c + g_c\,\big(\langle a, x_c\rangle - \mathrm{GAP}(x)_c\big).$$

key_hyperparams.name: mix_bias b
key_hyperparams.role: global bias toward GAP at init

init_recovers: GAP when mix_bias→−∞ so g_c→0 (stays close at init)
diff_from_baseline: Versus AvgMax / attention-pool, builds a softmax-attention branch over channel-mean logits, then per-channel-mixes with GAP using a sigmoid gate of normalized variance (low-spread channels stay GAP, textured channels lean saliency). Falls back to GAP on 1×1 maps.

name: Signed GeM + Spatial-Std Mix
tagline: Generalized-mean pooling on |x|^p with sign recovery, blended with a sign-corrected spatial std term via a learnable α (clamped ≤0.1).
init_recovers: GeM (Radenovic et al.) when α→0 — exactly matches the gem baseline at init since w_v = 0 and σ(0)·0.1 = 0.05
diff_from_baseline: Versus GeM, runs power-mean on |x|^p with explicit sign recovery from channel mean and adds a small (≤10%) spatial-std contribution. Skips entirely on 1×1 maps to avoid disturbing VGG/MobileNet classifiers.
